resolutions.title: The acceptance fixture asserts the classification it claims to derive
resolutions.action: Conceded in full: the fixture selected by INDEX, labelled in comments, checked an opening phrase, and hand-attached a pass list that never went near the write gate — so it could not have detected a wrong sort, and in fact detected none of the defects this same review found. Rewritten so every classification is settled by the ENGINE: a scratch project is seeded with rc02c's REAL pass files, qualifying entries compose a readiness record that `composeAndWriteEmit` ACCEPTS citing real tokens, and non-qualifying entries cite nothing, so `formed_against` is empty and the gate REFUSES them — the exclusion is now demonstrated by the engine rather than by a phrase check. Added: the in-context citation is refused (independence enforced, not assumed), and the continuation case composes from rc02c's own archived `gate_overridden` and is asserted to AGREE with it field-for-field plus refuse on each mismatch. The index-and-phrase assertions survive only where that is honestly their job — pinning the IDENTITY of the archived entry a claim is about, so the test breaks if the cited artifact moves. 6 cases, all green.
